ideas.title: The Fallout from the DOJ Investigation into Jerome Powell
ideas.description: This story would investigate the implications of the DOJ's decision to drop its investigation into Fed Chair Jerome Powell. What does this mean for the Federal Reserve and the US economy?
questions: What were the motivations behind the investigation's closure?
How will this development impact the Federal Reserve and the US economy?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant information about the Federal Reserve and the US economy. Further research is needed to determine the implications of the investigation's closure.

ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scandal: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future scandal, including the allegations of fraud and mismanagement of funds intended for a food program. What are the implications of this scandal for government accountability and transparency?
questions: What is the extent of the scandal?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant information about government accountability and transparency. Further research is needed to determine the extent of the scandal and the involvement of government officials.
